[1/2] UI readability cycle: quarter-mag LOW AMMO warning + reload progress bar, visual pairs and unchanged play hashes

impact_assessment.why: Low magazine and reload state were only visible as distant top-left numbers.
impact_assessment.benefits: Glanceable near-crosshair ammo state without duplicating exact counts.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (draw-only); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: reads sim ammo/reload only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin threshold/reload-bar/replacement tests; compare play hashes to the prior cycle.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Ammo HUD proven: 80 tests, determinism 1800 ok, 2420/1816px pairs, identical kite/strafe hashes; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-09-ammo-hud' completed successfully.
[1/2] Combat-feel cycle: non-lethal hit flinch (squash/push/hot material), visual pair and same-hash runs

impact_assessment.why: Body shots left enemies visually unchanged; only the crosshair and particles reacted.
impact_assessment.benefits: Immediate target reaction makes hits readable without touching damage or hitboxes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none (snapshot unchanged); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: hit_t is a transient sim timer and juice DATA.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin timer/expiry/scene tests, keep hit_t out of snapshot, compare play hashes to cycle 9.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Hit flinch proven: 83 tests, determinism 1800 ok, 3839px enemy pair, identical kite/strafe hashes; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-10-hit-flinch' completed successfully.
[1/2] Enemies cycle: cover collision/slide-around/spawn guard, re-recorded 3000-frame reference, visual pair and run

impact_assessment.why: Enemies walked straight through covers while the player and hitscan rays collided; cover was decorative for melee.
impact_assessment.benefits: Cover now blocks all enemy movement, improving level meaning and positioning without changing damage or hitboxes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: enemy positions/timings and campaign reference change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: cover_boxes derived at reset.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Heading-sweep slide, spawn guard, cover tests, re-recorded 3000-frame reference and fresh fairness/outcome runs.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Cover collision proven: 86 tests, determinism 1800 ok, 3116px pair, fair witnessed_win:2627; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-11-cover-collision' completed successfully.
[1/2] Levels cycle: jumpable rear-left platform, failing-first landing test, capture pair and platform run

impact_assessment.why: All covers were taller than the jump apex, so E/up could never land on anything.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds verticality/landmark and a real use for jump without changing enemy or weapon tables.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one extra cover changes pathing; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: platform derived from levels covers.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Corner placement keeps measured kite/strafe hashes identical; cover collision and spawn guard already apply; fairness re-run.

[1/2] UI readability cycle: typed kill event + last-four kill feed, visual pair and same-hash runs

impact_assessment.why: Kills only moved the distant score/streak numbers; no HUD line said what died or what it was worth.
impact_assessment.benefits: Immediate kill readability and useful event telemetry without touching sim damage/score.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new event string only (snapshot unchanged); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: feed timers are presentation-only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin typed event/amount and feed expiry tests; compare baseline/after play hashes.

[1/2] Graphics cycle: off-axis small muzzle flash via juice DATA, failing-first tests, first-shot pair and same-hash runs

impact_assessment.why: The 0.10 muzzle cube sat on the aim line and hid the crosshair/target for the flash window.
impact_assessment.benefits: Target stays visible during fire while the flash and light boost remain.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: flash_pos presentation field only (snapshot unchanged); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: juice DATA.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin offset/scale tests and compare play hashes to the pre-flash worktree.
